selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of a progressively enlarging finger with decreased sensation and limited flexion, along with the CT scan showing overgrowth of phalanges and surrounding soft tissue, best supports Macrodactyly as it directly explains the decisive findings of finger enlargement and functional impairment without contradiction.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma
rejected.why: No clear evidence of nerve involvement or neurofibromatosis characteristics

rejected.label: Lipomatosis of nerve
rejected.why: While lipomatous changes are noted, the primary issue seems to be macrodactyly rather than nerve involvement

rejected.label: Lipomatous process
rejected.why: Too broad and less specific compared to Macrodactyly

rejected.label: Lipomatous hemangioma
rejected.why: Although it involves lipomatous changes, the primary clinical presentation aligns more closely with Macrodactyly
